gold: Acute myocardial infarction due to critical stenosis of the proximal left anterior descending artery, presenting with de Winter ECG pattern evolving to Wellens syndrome

selector.rationale: High troponin level and ECG changes with ST-segment elevation and reciprocal depression, along with coronary angiography showing 95% stenosis of the proximal left anterior descending artery, strongly support myocardial infarction

rejected.label: Hypertensive Heart Disease
